name: Tasmania
summary: A British blue ensign with a white disc in the fly bearing a red lion passant.
origin: Tasmania, originally Van Diemen's Land, adopted the red lion badge in 1876. The flag was formally proclaimed in 1975.

symbols.name: Red lion
symbols.description: A red lion passant on white.

facts: Tasmania was called Van Diemen's Land until 1856.
It is the only island state of Australia.
clues: A blue ensign with a red lion on a white disc.
The flag of Australia's island state.
Its state was once called Van Diemen's Land.
